title: Walls And Gates
prompt: You are given an m x n grid rooms. Fill each empty room with the distance to its nearest gate. If it is impossible to reach a gate, it should be filled with 2^31 - 1. A gate is at (r,c) if rooms[r][c] == 0. Empty room is -1. Walls are -1.

examples.output: Rooms updated with distances to nearest gate

hints: Multi-source BFS from all gates (value 0). For each empty room, the first time we reach it is the shortest distance.
Queue all gates with dist 0. When visiting (r,c), try 4 neighbors: if empty (INF), set rooms[nr][nc] = dist+1, enqueue.
This way each empty room gets the distance from the nearest gate.
